issues.issue_name: Annual Roof Inspection and Tune-Up Recommended
issues.issue_description: Roofs may leak at anytime. Leaks often appear at roof penetrations, flashings, changes in direction or changes in material. A roof leak should be addressed promptly to avoid damage to the structure, interior finishes and furnishings. We recommend an annual inspection and tune-up to minimize the risk of leakage and to maximize the life of roofs.
issues.issue_summary: The inspector recommends an annual roof inspection and tune-up as a preventative measure to minimize the risk of leaks and maximize the roof's lifespan.

issues.issue_name: Downspout Discharges Too Close to Foundation
issues.issue_description: ROOF DRAINAGE \ Downspouts. Condition: Discharge too close to building. The downspout should be extended to discharge at least 6 feet from the home. Implication(s): Chance of water damage to structure, finishes and contents. Task: Improve.
issues.issue_summary: A downspout discharges water too close to the foundation, increasing the risk of water damage and basement leaks. The downspout should be extended to discharge at least 6 feet away from the house.

issues.issue_description: Condition: Too few downspouts. More downspouts will help reduce the risk of basement flooding. A good rule of thumb is that there should be a downspout for every 35 feet of gutter. Implication(s): Chance of water damage to structure, finishes and contents. Task: Provide.
issues.issue_summary: There are not enough downspouts for the length of the gutters, which can lead to overflows and increase the risk of basement flooding. Additional downspouts should be installed.

issues.issue_description: PORCHES, DECKS, STAIRS, PATIOS AND BALCONIES \ Joists. Condition: Fastener problems. Joist hangers for wood deck are not properly secured. Implication(s): Weakened structure | Chance of movement. Task: Improve.
issues.issue_summary: The joist hangers supporting the wood deck are not properly secured, weakening the structure and creating a safety hazard. The fasteners should be corrected by a qualified professional.

issues.issue_description: Condition: Abandoned wire. Implication(s): Electric shock. Task: Improve.
issues.issue_summary: An abandoned electrical wire was found in the furnace room, which poses an electric shock hazard. The wire should be properly terminated or removed by a qualified electrician.

issues.issue_name: Wiring Too Close to Edge of Studs/Joists
issues.issue_description: Condition: Too close to edge of studs or joists. Implication(s): Electric shock, Fire hazard. Task: Improve.
issues.issue_summary: Electrical wiring is installed too close to the edge of framing members, making it vulnerable to damage from fasteners and creating a fire and shock hazard. The wiring should be repositioned or protected.

issues.issue_description: Condition: Loose. Implication(s): Electric shock, Fire hazard. Task: Repair or replace. Also noted as 'Light fixture is not well secured'.
issues.issue_summary: An exterior light fixture is loose, creating a potential fire and electric shock hazard. The fixture should be properly secured or replaced.
